summary: MID2DWM.EXE packer identified as Borland TLINK EXEPACK variant; decompressor stub fully reverse-engineered and published (first public documentation of this format variant). Pure-Python unpacker decodes the stream; first 42 bytes of the unpacked image verified as coherent Borland C0 startup code. Long-run distance encoding remains the single blocking unknown (56-variant brute force negative), so the .dwm opcode table is NOT yet pinned. Envelope facts of F-41 unchanged.

provenance.sdk: archive.org DiamondWaresSoundToolKit_1020 stk12.zip -> STK102.EXE (LHa SFX v2.13S), all 38 files extracted at exact sizes
provenance.converter: MID2DWM.EXE 48923 bytes, MZ load module 48891 B @0x20, entry CS:IP 0x0BDA:0x000E, e_crlc=0
provenance.tools: capstone 5.0.7 16-bit disassembly; hand-written pure-Python lh5 decoder (lhasa lh_new_decoder.c port); token-walk unpacker

exepack_stub.variant: Borland TLINK EXEPACK (distinct from Microsoft EXEPACK 4.x on moddingwiki)
exepack_stub.runtime_flow: stub self-copies +0x7E1 paras; payload (0x0BDA paras) moved up 0x7E1 paras freeing image hole; forward unpack from DS:SI=0/ES:DI=0; reloc walk (none); ljmp real_cs:real_ip

unpacked_image.approx_size: ~79KB (CS at byte 0x135F0), larger than 48.5KB payload (expansion via runs)

token_grammar.bitstream: 16-bit little-endian flag words via lodsw; bits consumed LSB-first (shr bp,1); raw payload bytes (literals, distance bytes, long words) interleaved in the same stream sharing SI
token_grammar.literal: flag bit 1 -> append next raw byte

run.short: flag bit 0 (bit2=0): count = 2 flag bits + 2 (2..5); 1 raw byte; dist = 0x100 - byte (1..256)
run.long: flag bit 0 (bit2=1): 1 raw word w; count-code = (w>>8)&7: nonzero -> count = code+2 (3..9); zero -> 1 raw byte c: 0 = END-OF-STREAM, 1 = pointer-normalize marker (DI->0x2000+(DI&0xF), ES-=-0x200; DS/SI likewise), >=2 -> count = c+1 (3..256); DIST ENCODING OPEN (natural reading 0x10000-((0xE0|(hi>>3))<<8|lo) rejected by stream at token 37)

token_grammar.verification: 36 consecutive tokens reproduce exact Borland C0 startup (A1 44 00 / 0B 06 42 00 / 74 0D / FF 36 ... / 55 / E8 ...) — machine-code coherent
token_grammar.brute_force: 7 distance formulas x 2 count variants x 2 short-count bit orders x 4 short-dist formulas = 56 combos: no full decode

lha_sfx_header_variant.note: STK102.EXE LHa SFX uses non-standard headers (no skip/attr bytes); breaks lhafile C extension
lha_sfx_header_variant.layout: [method 5B][packed u32le][orig u32le][time u32le][res u16=0x0020][nlen u8][name][crc u16][ext u16]; data at method+24+nlen; next header at data_end (chain-verified 38/38)

dwm_grammar_status.envelope: PROVEN (F-41): records [delta:u8][type:u8][params] of 4 or 5 bytes; exactly one {4,5} solution satisfies body_len=4a+5b, a+b=event_count on all 8 files; 0x0B = end-of-song
dwm_grammar_status.opcode_semantics: NOT PINNED — converter unpack blocked; PLAYDWM.C has no event dispatch (API caller only); DWS.H/DWT.H/STKMAN.DOC contain no opcode enumeration; DWS.LIB event loop is OMF with obfuscated symbols

sample_revalidation.end_marker_note: body holds 42 0x0B bytes; final tail ...06 3F 0F 03 — 0x0B not the naive final type byte (consistent with F-41 'reachable' status)
